title: 1st Year MBBS Professional Result 2026 Declared
content: Gomal Medical College is pleased to announce that the First Professional MBBS Annual Examination 2026 result, conducted under Gomal University, has been declared. Students may view their result online or collect the detail marks certificate from the Examination Branch.

title: MBBS Admissions 2026-27 Open
content: Applications are invited for admission to the MBBS program at Gomal Medical College for the session 2026-27 through the ETEA / Provincial Merit process. Eligible candidates must apply before the closing date. Read the prospectus carefully before applying.

title: Fee Submission Deadline Extended
content: The last date for submission of tuition and examination fee for the current semester has been extended to 20 July 2026. Late fee will apply thereafter. Pay at the designated bank branch and submit the receipt to the Accounts Office.

title: Send-Up Examination Schedule (Final Year MBBS)
content: The date sheet for the Final Year MBBS Send-Up Examination has been uploaded. Examinations will commence from 28 July 2026. Students are advised to check their roll number slips from the Examination Branch.

title: Summer Vacation Notice
content: The college will observe summer vacation from 15 July to 31 July 2026. Regular classes will resume on 1 August 2026. Hostel residents should coordinate with the hostel warden regarding stay arrangements.

title: Anti-Ragging Committee Notification
content: All students are informed that ragging in any form is strictly prohibited within the college and hostel premises. Any incident should be reported immediately to the Anti-Ragging Committee. Strict disciplinary action will be taken against violators.

title: Guest Lecture on Antimicrobial Resistance
content: The Department of Pharmacology is organising a guest lecture on Antimicrobial Resistance and Rational Prescribing in the College Auditorium on 12 July 2026 at 10:00 AM. Attendance is mandatory for 3rd and 4th year students.

title: Clinical Rotations Roster (3rd Year)
content: The updated clinical rotations roster for 3rd Year MBBS students at the affiliated teaching hospital has been issued. Students must report to their assigned wards as per the schedule. Attendance shortfall may affect eligibility for the professional examination.

title: Scholarship Applications Invited
content: Applications for need-based and merit scholarships for the session 2026-27 are now open. Eligible students may collect the application form from the Student Affairs Office and submit the completed form with supporting documents before the deadline.

title: Annual Sports Gala 2026
content: Gomal Medical College is organising its Annual Sports Gala from 20 to 25 August 2026. Students interested in participating should register their names with their respective class representatives before 10 August 2026.
